name: dev.tanod/tanod
title: Tanod
description: Local client for the hosted Tanod API: PDF, image, web, DNS, crypto, weather and search tools. Free daily allowance; optional capped x402 USDC payments.

environmentVariables.name: TANOD_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional EVM private key of a wallet holding USDC on Base, used to pay for calls beyond the free daily allowance via x402. Unset means free tier only.

environmentVariables.name: TANOD_MAX_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Refuse to sign any single payment above this many US dollars.

environmentVariables.name: TANOD_MAX_USD_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Refuse to sign once the UTC-day total would exceed this many US dollars.

environmentVariables.name: TANOD_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Upstream MCP URL (testing only). Must be https; plain http only for loopback.

environmentVariables.name: TANOD_BASE_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Base mainnet JSON-RPC URL you trust (https). Lets the client release a sent payment's hold once a finalized block shows the authorization expired unused. Unset keeps such holds until reconciled manually.
